description_en: An S-shaped conversation seat with two opposing seat bowls connected by a central curved woven back; the front shows the offset seat entries, the side reveals alternating back directions, and the rear shows the reverse seat and continuous serpentine structural rail. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT reference of this exact product. Create ONE photorealistic alternate catalog view of THAT SAME OBJECT, rotating viewpoint only. Subject: An S-shaped conversation seat with two opposing seat bowls connected by a central curved woven back; the front shows the offset seat entries, the side reveals alternating back directions, and the rear shows the reverse seat and continuous serpentine structural rail. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.. Style Royal: formal symmetry and graceful bound borders without emblems. Relative size compact within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: close herringbone V-shaped twill. Finish: deep walnut-brown dye with visible fiber grain. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact RIGHT-SIDE ELEVATION: orbit camera 90 degrees to the object's right from its canonical front, level with product center. Show its right profile; front-facing panel must be edge-on. Do not merely flip or mirror the front image. Preserve exact silhouette dimensions, finish color, weave, number and locations of all compartments, handles, legs, ribs, drawers, hinges, padding and secondary materials. Reveal the described previously hidden surfaces without redesigning the object. Match background, soft lighting, scale and center placement. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions. CRITICAL SIDE ANGLE: The canonical front image shows the LONG horizontal span of this two-seat S-shaped conversation chair, with its two seat centers side-by-side left and right along the long axis. Orbit camera EXACTLY 90 degrees to the object's RIGHT END and look along that LONG axis. Show a NARROW END ELEVATION, where the near right rounded seat shell is foreground and partly occludes the far left seat; the S-shaped dividing back recedes into depth. Do not show both seat compartments spread horizontally across a broad long-side silhouette. Do not rotate only 30 or 45 degrees. Do not return another long front or rear view. Preserve exactly two opposing circular seats, continuous S-shaped divider, dark walnut finish, tight herringbone weave, original arms, legs and bamboo rail geometry. Use a level long-lens camera at product center height, no overhead angle.
